version.changelog: Fix: strip residual n8n metadata, fix process.env to $env, add webhook HMAC validation, add crosspost auth

llm.summary: This is a legitimate Shopify automation skill, but it needs review because its public webhook can accept unauthenticated order data and the workflows handle customer PII and automated emails without enough safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Shopify tokens, Google Sheets OAuth, SMTP credentials, customer PII storage, and customer/admin emails are broadly proportionate to the purpose, but the public webhook and email paths need stronger validation, escaping, consent, and retention guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown metadata and n8n workflow JSON files; no installer, local command execution, dependency installation, or remote payload retrieval was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The new-order webhook only verifies HMAC when both a secret and signature are present, so missing configuration or a missing signature lets processing continue into Sheets writes and admin email sends.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Recurring n8n schedules and Google Sheets persistence are disclosed, but abandoned-cart recovery can repeatedly email the same checkout because no send-state, suppression, or deduplication control is defined.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The Shopify, Google Sheets, and SMTP capabilities fit the stated order-management purpose, including order logging, status sync, inventory alerts, cart recovery, and reporting.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Do not enable the public webhook or customer recovery emails until webhook verification fails closed using the raw request body, email content is escaped and recovery URLs are validated, and you have clear privacy, retention, access-control, opt-out, and deduplication rules for customer data.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced workflow files are present in the artifact and were inspected, so the partial-inspection scanner signal is not evidence of evasive behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Customer/order data storage in Google Sheets and admin/customer emails are expected for this skill, but the documentation does not give enough privacy, retention, consent, unsubscribe, or sheet-access guidance.
[SDI-1] expected: Email delivery is disclosed in the main instructions and credential table, though the one-line manifest description under-emphasizes SMTP/customer recovery email behavior.
[T09] unexpected: The fail-open webhook authentication issue is artifact-backed and material because unauthenticated requests can trigger order logging and admin notification with workflow credentials.
[T09] unexpected: Shopify and webhook-derived fields are inserted into HTML email bodies without escaping, creating phishing or misleading-content risk in outgoing messages.
[T09] unexpected: The abandoned-cart workflow runs every three hours and lacks persistent send tracking, so the same customer can receive repeated recovery emails.
